The grant is squarely on the topic of the lead (depressed-collector effectiveness in gyrotron systems), matching the High-power microwave / advanced gyrotron engineering / ECRH hardware scope.
- Low confidence / explicit negative: No 2026-dated Hogge-specific job posting (open or closed/historical) was retrieved through EPFL, LinkedIn, or EURAXESS channels. Existence of such a posting cannot be ruled out from public sources only.
- Caveats on terminology: The lead input uses "Swiss Plasma Center (SPC) - Gyrotron Development"; the EPFL directory surfaces the same person under the SPC - International Installations unit. These labels are consistent given SPC's internal structure (Hogge's unit handles external-machine collaborations including gyrotron-relevant work), but the report flag this so a downstream reviewer can reconcile labels.
- Caveats on coverage: CORDIS / Horizon Europe direct project lists were searched generically; if Hogge participates in EUROfusion workpackage-funded projects, those budget lines are usually mission-aligned/consortium-funded rather than individually awarded, so they may not surface under his name in funding databases (not confirmed or denied here).
- Caveats on dates: All dates reproduced verbatim from SNSF data portal entries. This report does not invent any "as of 2026" announcements or numbers; where a record was not found, the report explicitly says so.
